mission.title: Courier
mission.description: Carry a data disk between two Zion couriers.

phase.briefing: Leto has a data disk for another member of our network. Meet Leto, collect the disk, and take it to the next address.

enter.say: Speak to Leto before collecting the disk.

objective.text: Get the data disk from Leto

phase.briefing: Take the disk to Neris. Make sure it reaches the right hands.

objective.text: Give the data disk to Neris

complete.say: The disk arrived safely. Thank you, {player}.
